name: optimize_kotlin_fib_naive_recursion
description: Optimizes an exponential-time naive recursive Fibonacci to a linear iterative implementation
prompts: Fib.of(n: Long): Long in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Fib.kt computes the n-th Fibonacci number (of(0)=0, of(1)=1) via naive double recursion: `of(n-1) + of(n-2)`. That recomputes the same sub-values exponentially many times and becomes far too slow once n is in the low 40s. Rewrite of(n) to run in linear time (an iterative loop, or memoization) while returning the exact same values, including of(0)=0 and of(1)=1. Keep the object name and the of(n: Long): Long signature. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
